fundamental.rule: Use VCI first. Use MAS only when VCI errors or returns empty. Preserve exact source per symbol-report-period and never silently overwrite VCI with MAS.

company_metadata.rule: Prefer VCI for company profile and classification; retain cohort metadata as the historical listing anchor source.

market_daily.note: The completed v4.1 daily OHLCV lake is retained; no unnecessary re-download solely for source switching.

cash_flow.rule: Re-audit quarterly CF coverage under VCI before accepting MAS sparsity as true missing data.
